visualCharacteristics.purpose: Related link list (Related content, Associated procedures, Products & services) collapsed after 6 items
visualCharacteristics.description: Single column of underlined blue links; when there are more than 6, the rest are hidden behind a "Show N more" text button with a chevron, which toggles to "Show less".

contentPattern.structure: One row per link to a detail page
contentPattern.description: The list length varies per page and every item links to a detail page, so it is Cards with one cell per row. The H2 above it stays default content. Author every item, including those hidden behind "Show N more"; the code collapses after 6.
contentPattern.blockContent: Related content links (e.g. Atrial fibrillation ablation, Holter monitor ...)

usage: List of related links under a default-content H2 in the condition article.
reuseGuidance: Use for a plain list of links whose length varies. For bordered link rows in two columns use cards-link-list.
